notes: every certificate is real: ML-DSA from cryptography, Falcon and SLH-DSA from pq_certs.py (same profile, signed with liboqs, chain verified)
FN-DSA has no object identifier; Falcon uses a same-length placeholder in NIST's signature arc
cert_der_bytes_model is the earlier model, public key + signature + 542 B, kept for comparison
Falcon and SLH-DSA have no COSE algorithm identifier assigned; the structure uses a placeholder and the size is unaffected
classical rows use real certificates and carry no timing
chain_depth is the hierarchy from leaf to root; x5chain carries certs_carried = depth - 1 certificates, the root omitted
